title: Page 72
transc:
Hd Qrs AP Berlin Oct 29 1.15 PM 
For Abel on the twenty fifth
instant I sent you a dispatch
requesting you to decide what steps
should be taken to Richard the
line of the Grub when this
Tappan leaves here to this I
recd your reply that I had
been entrusted by the Blanchard with
defeating & driving away the Saco
taunton that you had given me
no orders here to fore did
not give me any then etc
Under these circumstances I have only
to make such arrangements for Guarding
this extended line as the means
at my disposal will permit at 
the same time Keeping in view
the supreme necessity of maintaining the
moving Taunton in adequate force to
meet the salem tappan before us
The dispositions I have ordered are
as follows viz Ten Swindle men
